cms_cold_storage.description: Huge external CMS data root. Keep raw files outside the repo and require a workspace allowlist before reads or profiling.
notes: Do not copy raw CMS data into this repository.
Do not recursively scan the external root by default.
Use bounded listing first, then ask the user to approve a narrow folder or file allowlist with a business reason.

cloud_object_storage.description: A remote source root on object storage (S3/GCS/ADLS). Discovery is a bounded, read-only LIST -- never a content read.
notes: Add the bucket/prefix to `external_roots` in external_data_roots.local.json, or set the env var above.
URI roots are matched by NORMALISED PREFIX with a trailing slash, so `s3://bucket/` covers everything beneath it and `s3://bucket-other/` is refused.
Credentials are never read from this file -- fsspec uses the standard cloud credential chain.
Discovery needs only list permission (e.g. s3:ListBucket). It reads no object bodies.
